verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an account-management app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented way to select and act on many accounts or items at once. Cloud backup of all accounts and password export are separate data-portability features, not a general bulk-operation capability, so they earn no credit. No API, CLI, or automation surface is documented either (the llms.txt and OpenAPI probes returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
